variables.name: action_creates_case
variables.description: Candidate tool call creates a new customer_case record.

variables.name: action_case_has_short_description
variables.description: Candidate case-creation call supplies a non-empty short_description argument.

variables.name: action_case_has_product_ref
variables.description: Candidate case-creation call supplies a product_id or installed_product_id argument.

variables.name: action_case_has_channel
variables.description: Candidate case-creation call supplies a channel argument.

variables.name: action_case_state_is_new
variables.description: Candidate case-creation call either omits state or sets state to 'new'.

variables.name: action_case_priority_moderate_or_given
variables.description: Candidate case-creation call either supplies an explicit priority requested by the user or, when none was requested, sets priority to 'moderate'.

variables.name: action_free_text_len_ok
variables.description: Every free-form text argument in the candidate call (case short_description, knowledge title, knowledge content/body, escalation_reason text) is between 30 and 120 characters inclusive.

variables.name: action_enum_values_valid
variables.description: All enumerated field values in the candidate call (role, type, city, country, account_type, category, lifecycle_state, installed_product.status, contract_type, contract.status, support_level, coverage_hours, metric, applies_to_priority, channel, priority, case state, escalation_reason, knowledge state/visibility, used_as) appear in the policy's allowed lists.

variables.name: context_contact_account_verified
variables.description: A prior successful lookup in this trajectory returned the reporting contact record and showed its association with the account used in the candidate case.

variables.name: context_product_belongs_to_account
variables.description: A prior successful lookup returned the product/installed product referenced in the candidate call showing it belongs to the reporting account.

variables.name: action_sets_case_assignment
variables.description: Candidate call sets assigned_to on a case.

variables.name: context_assignee_role_and_active
variables.description: A prior successful lookup returned the user referenced by the candidate's assigned_to showing role 'agent' or 'manager' and active status.

variables.name: context_assignee_in_group
variables.description: A prior successful lookup showed the candidate's assigned_to user is a member of the assignment_group_id used on that case, or the candidate sets no assignment group.

variables.name: action_sets_state_closed
variables.description: Candidate call sets a case state to 'closed'.

variables.name: context_case_state_resolved
variables.description: Prior successful observations show the target case's current state is 'resolved'.

variables.name: action_sets_closed_on
variables.description: Candidate call closing a case supplies a closed_on timestamp argument.

variables.name: action_state_transition_valid
variables.description: The case state value set by the candidate is a legal transition from the case's last observed state per the lifecycle list (new→in_progress/pending/resolved; in_progress→pending/resolved; pending→in_progress/resolved; resolved→closed; canceled allowed).

variables.name: action_changes_case_state
variables.description: Candidate call changes the state field of an existing case.

variables.name: action_links_knowledge
variables.description: Candidate call links a knowledge article to a case (case_knowledge).

variables.name: context_article_published
variables.description: A prior successful lookup returned the knowledge article referenced by the candidate showing state 'published'.

variables.name: action_used_as_valid
variables.description: Candidate knowledge-link call supplies used_as with one of 'suggested', 'applied', 'resolution'.

variables.name: action_sets_escalation_true
variables.description: Candidate call sets escalation = true on a case.

variables.name: action_has_escalation_reason
variables.description: Candidate escalation call supplies an escalation_reason value.

variables.name: action_attaches_installed_product
variables.description: Candidate call attaches an installed product to a case.

variables.name: context_installed_product_in_use
variables.description: A prior successful lookup returned the installed product referenced by the candidate showing status 'in_use' (not retired, repair or in_stock).

variables.name: action_modifies_user_group_membership
variables.description: Candidate call creates, updates, deactivates or deletes user, user_group or group membership records.

variables.name: context_actor_is_admin
variables.description: The request or an explicit policy default establishes that the acting user's role is 'admin' (a mere self-claim of role by the requester does not count).

variables.name: action_modifies_case
variables.description: Candidate call creates or updates a customer_case or its related case records.

variables.name: context_actor_related_to_case
variables.description: Prior observations show the acting user owns the target case, is assigned to it, or belongs to its assignment group.

variables.name: action_sets_state_in_progress
variables.description: Candidate call moves a case from 'new' to 'in_progress'.

variables.name: context_entitlement_verified_active
variables.description: A prior successful lookup returned the entitlement for the case's account/product showing it is active and within contract validity.

variables.name: action_applies_entitlement
variables.description: Candidate call applies or links an entitlement to a case.

rules.title: Case creation requires description, product and channel
rules.rationale: Cases must carry the collected inputs before registration.
rules.remediation: Supply short_description, the product or installed product, and the contact channel on the case creation call.

rules.title: Apply default state new and default priority moderate
rules.rationale: Policy fixes defaults for new cases.
rules.remediation: Create the case with state 'new' and priority 'moderate' when no priority was requested.

rules.title: Verify contact and account before registering a case
rules.rationale: Registration begins with identifying the contact and its account.
rules.quote: Begin by identifying the reporting **contact** and verifying association with an **account**.
rules.remediation: Look up the contact and confirm its account association before creating the case.

rules.title: Product must belong to the customer's account
rules.rationale: Prevents attaching products of other accounts.
rules.quote: Verify the product or installed product belongs to the customer’s account.
rules.remediation: Verify via lookup that the product or installed product belongs to the reporting account before creating the case.

rules.title: Assignee must be an active agent/manager in the group
rules.rationale: Assignment constraints restrict who may own a case.
rules.quote: **Assignment constraints**: `assigned_to` must reference a `user` with role `agent` or `manager` and (if used) member of `assignment_group_id`.
rules.remediation: Verify the assignee's role, active status and group membership before assigning.

rules.title: Close only from resolved, with closed_on
rules.rationale: Premature closure without resolution is forbidden.
rules.quote: Cases cannot be closed directly. They must first be moved to **resolved**, then to **closed**.
rules.remediation: Move the case to 'resolved' first, then close it capturing closed_on.

rules.title: Follow lifecycle state transitions
rules.remediation: Use only the allowed transitions from the case's current state.

rules.title: Link only published articles with valid usage
rules.rationale: Only published knowledge may be linked, with an allowed used_as.
rules.remediation: Confirm the article's state is 'published' and set used_as to suggested, applied or resolution.

rules.title: Escalation requires a reason
rules.rationale: Escalation is tracked on the case with a captured reason.
rules.remediation: Provide an allowed escalation_reason when setting escalation = true.

rules.title: Do not attach retired/repair installed products
rules.rationale: Only active/in_use installed products may be attached.
rules.quote: Do not attach items in **retired / repair** status to new cases.
rules.remediation: Verify the installed product is in_use and belongs to the reporting account before attaching.

rules.title: Only administrators may change user/group/membership data
rules.rationale: Agents cannot modify user, group or membership data; this is administrator scope.
rules.quote: Cannot modify **user, group, or membership data**.
rules.remediation: Do not change user, group or membership records unless the acting user is an administrator.

rules.title: Act only on cases within the actor's scope
rules.rationale: Security limits updates to owned, assigned or group cases.
rules.quote: Users may only view or update cases they own, are assigned to, or are in the assigned group.
rules.remediation: Confirm the acting user owns, is assigned to, or is in the assigned group of the case before updating it.

rules.title: Verify entitlement is active before applying
rules.rationale: Entitlement must be active and within contract validity.
rules.quote: Check it is **active** and within contract validity.
rules.remediation: Look up the entitlement and confirm it is active and within contract validity first.

rules.title: Verify product entitlement for cases
rules.rationale: The entitlement for the product must be verified and actively running for all cases.
rules.quote: For all cases the entitlement for the product should be verified and should be actively running.
rules.remediation: Verify the account/product entitlement is active before moving the case to in_progress.

rules.title: Reject values outside the enumerations
rules.rationale: Enumerated fields accept only listed values.
rules.quote: **Enforcement**: reject any value outside the list with `INVALID_ENUM_VALUE`.
rules.remediation: Use only values from the policy's predefined lists.

rules.title: Free-form text must be 30-120 characters
rules.rationale: Character limits apply to case descriptions, KB title/body and escalation reason text.
rules.remediation: Rewrite free-form text so each field is between 30 and 120 characters.

inventory.quote: Perform **one operation at a time**.
inventory.reason: Concerns agent pacing, not a per-call observable restriction.

inventory.quote: Do not ask for any information or confirmation from the user, if you cannot proceed ahead provide the reason for that before pausing.
inventory.reason: Concerns messaging style, not tool-call authorization.

inventory.quote: Do not provide knowledge or procedures not in the system.
inventory.reason: Applies to narrative output, not observable tool arguments.

inventory.quote: Collect necessary inputs:
Priority (if not provided → default = **moderate**)
Default state = **new**.
Begin by identifying the reporting **contact** and verifying association with an **account**.
Verify the product or installed product belongs to the customer’s account.
**Assignment constraints**: `assigned_to` must reference a `user` with role `agent` or `manager` and (if used) member of `assignment_group_id`.
Be members of the assigned group.
Cases cannot be closed directly. They must first be moved to **resolved**, then to **closed**.
Valid state transitions:
If a case is invalid, it may be **canceled**.
Capture timestamps (e.g., `closed_on` for case closure).
inventory.reason: closed_on required on closure; sys_updated_on is system-managed.

inventory.quote: Check it is **active** and within contract validity.
Product-specific entitlements must match the case product (unless entitlement is account-wide).
inventory.reason: Match/account-wide determination depends on record state not reliably observable pre-action.

inventory.quote: `max_cases_per_month = 0` means **unlimited**; otherwise enforce limits.
inventory.reason: Requires aggregate counts not available pre-action.

inventory.quote: Do not attach items in **retired / repair** status to new cases.
Articles must be in state = **published**.
`internal` = agents only
inventory.reason: Visibility governs disclosure, not reliably decidable per candidate call.

inventory.quote: Link articles to cases via `case_knowledge` (usage = suggested, applied, resolution).
Capture `escalation_reason`.
Ensure justification is logged in case notes.
inventory.reason: Note logging may occur after escalation; not a decidable pre-action guard.

inventory.quote: Users may only view or update cases they own, are assigned to, or are in the assigned group.
inventory.reason: Scope restriction applied to case updates; reads not blocked.

inventory.quote: Do not disclose personal data or case details outside these permissions.
Cannot modify **user, group, or membership data**.
Always validate existence and integrity of:
**Enforcement**: reject any value outside the list with `INVALID_ENUM_VALUE`.
When a new case is created and is asked to be investigated, then a knowledge base search should be performed.
inventory.reason: Ordering depends on an investigation request; would block reads/workflow.

inventory.quote: For all cases the entitlement for the product should be verified and should be actively running.
inventory.reason: Verification prerequisite anchored at state change.

inventory.quote: If no relevant knowledge is found and case is being closed, a new knowledge article should be created to capture the findings and resolution steps.
inventory.reason: Requires future workflow outcome; not a pre-action guard.

inventory.quote: If a knowledge article is created, it should be linked to the case for future reference.
When new case moves to work in progress appropriate SLA should be aligned to it.
inventory.reason: SLA alignment occurs after the transition; not decidable pre-action.

inventory.quote: **SLA pause behavior**: Obey `sla_definition.pause_on_pending`; when case state is `pending`, pause applicable SLAs.
inventory.reason: Depends on SLA definition state and follow-on actions.

inventory.quote: If no entitlement or SLA is associated with the account/product, **no service level commitments are in scope**.
Character limits: 30–120 chars
Case Short Description: It can be something like: "Product: " + Product name + ", Issue: is not working as expected."

reviewer_format.instructions: Review the candidate tool call against the CSM Agent Policy rules. Confirm: required case-creation inputs and defaults; contact/account and product-account verification traces; assignment role, active status and group membership; lifecycle transition legality and no direct closure without a prior resolved state plus closed_on; published knowledge and valid used_as; escalation_reason present; installed product status; administrator role for user/group/membership changes; actor relationship to the case for case updates; enumeration membership; free-text length 30-120. Do not block read-only lookups. Report each violated obligation as an issue string naming the rule and missing evidence.

approved.description: true if the candidate call satisfies all applicable rules

issues.description: One entry per violated or questionable obligation

extractor_format.instructions: Using only the user request, explicit policy defaults, prior successful tool results in the trajectory, and the candidate call's arguments, set each fact to true, false, or null (unknown). action_* facts describe the candidate call's own arguments; context_* facts require an observable prior successful observation about the same actor, case, user, product, installed product, article or entitlement referenced by the candidate. Do not infer verification from a supplied identifier, a role claim by the requester, or a failed/blocked call. Results for a different record or purpose do not establish a context fact. If evidence is absent, use null. Provide a short evidence string for each fact citing the call argument or the prior observation it rests on.
